week.title: AI让数学再也回不去那个旧世界了_投资界
week.summary:
1. 矩阵乘法。

Five American technology companies are pledging $2.4B to federal science. Nvidia is giving $1B, AMD $500M, OpenAI $200M, and Anthropic and Google $150M each. The money takes the form of AI tools and compute credits for the Genesis Mission. Trump announces it on Thursday at a Washington summit called Science: A New Golden Age, which also carries more than $100M for science and engineering education. month.title: Manus完成超5亿美元新一轮融资_投资界
month.summary:
北京蝴蝶效应科技有限公司（简称：蝴蝶效应）成立于2022年。据天眼查，蝴蝶效应是一家以从事科技推广和应用服务为主的企业。投资界（ID：pedaily2012）10月8日消息，Manus 母公司蝴蝶效应于近日完成超过 5 亿美元新一轮融资。本轮融资由博裕投资、IDG 资本领投，老股东腾讯、红杉中国、真格基金继续加持。
